description: This file defines the schema and API endpoints for the Warehouse plugin, including methods for hardware testing, device information retrieval, reset operations, and data cleaning.

methods.name: executeHardwareTest
methods.description: Starts a hardware test on the device.

methods.name: getHardwareTestResults
methods.description: Returns results of the last hardware test.

methods.name: internalReset
methods.description: Reboots the Warehouse service via internal script, with checks for production versions.

methods.name: isClean
methods.description: Checks for the presence of customer data on the device.

methods.name: resetDevice
methods.description: Resets the STB to Warehouse state, with possible event notification.

methods.name: setFrontPanelState
methods.description: Sets the front panel LED state to indicate software download status.
